key_results: MLP neural network predicted layer thickness with R = 0.987 (carrot), 0.995 (banana), 0.993 (apple); volumetric shrinkage validation R and RMSE of 0.988/3.82 (carrot), 0.950/4.97 (banana), 0.982/3.23 (apple)
comments: Non-contact laser-based approach achieves high accuracy for carrot and apple but lower for banana due to browning-induced laser absorption.

model_io.model: Multilayer perceptron predicting layer thickness as function of time, temperature, initial thickness

hypotheses.hypothesis: 3D laser imaging combined with MLP thickness prediction accurately measures volumetric shrinkage during thin-layer drying without destructive sampling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for carrot and apple; banana shows reduced accuracy due to optical effects

title: Secure routing in internet of things using software defined networking and chaos theory
task: Secure routing in IoT via SDN and chaos theory
key_results: 23.7% improvement in energy efficiency and 5.3% improvement in packet delivery ratio versus state-of-the-art protocols
comments: Two-stage design (topology control via SDN + lightweight chaotic encryption) is practical for resource-constrained networks but lacks detailed computational complexity analysis.

model_io.model: SDN controller with cluster pre-computation + dynamic chaotic encryption based on payload

hypotheses.hypothesis: SDN-based topology control combined with payload-adaptive chaotic encryption reduces reconfiguration overhead and improves energy efficiency in dynamic IoT networks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via simulation; 23.7% energy gain and 5.3% PDR improvement demonstrated

title: An adaptive hybrid forecasting framework for community net load considering distributed generation and nonlinear demand dynamics
task: Adaptive hybrid forecasting for community net load under high DPG penetration
key_results: Consistent outperformance of ARIMAX, LSTM, and CNN-LSTM on MSE, RMSE, MAE, MAPE across DPG scenarios
comments: Adaptive fusion mechanism dynamically weights linear and nonlinear branches, though absolute numerical improvements are not quantified in the abstract.

model_io.model: HDGMA-FM (ARIMAX linear branch + temporal kernel learning nonlinear branch with adaptive fusion)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive fusion of ARIMAX and nonlinear temporal kernel learning improves community net load prediction under high DPG penetration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via extensive experiments and ablation analysis on multiple scenarios

title: Decoding technology transition process through consumer behavior: experience from China’s electric vehicle evolution
task: Model technology transition from ICE to electric vehicles via heterogeneous consumer behavior
key_results: Three consumer segments (new, replacement, renewal) respond differently to cost/usability/charging; baseline scenario suggests EV stock overtakes ICEV around 2030; secondhand EV market after 2035 reshapes buyer composition
comments: Decision-based framework linking micro-adoption behavior to macro-fleet dynamics; cross-national comparison reveals institutional mediation of behavioral effects.

model_io.model: Dynamic simulation embedding three consumer segments with differential sensitivity to purchase cost, usability, charging conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Consumer heterogeneity and market development stage jointly determine the pace and trajectory of EV transition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; behavioral logics translate into market outcomes contingent on economic development and institutional capacity

title: Towards foundation-style models for energy-frontier heterogeneous neutrino detectors via self-supervised pretraining
task: Self-supervised pretraining for tera-scale neutrino detector event reconstruction
key_results: Sparse Vision Transformer with masked-autoencoder + relational objectives improves flavour/charm identification, momentum regression, vertex reconstruction; with ~10³ labelled events matches scratch-training performance of 10⁴-event models
comments: Foundation-style representation learning shows 10× data efficiency gain and cross-domain transfer; detector-subsystem ablations reveal physically plausible roles.

model_io.model: Sparse Vision Transformer with self-supervised pretraining (masked-autoencoder + relational voxel-level objectives) followed by joint fine-tuning
inputs: simulated neutrino events from FASER calorimeter, plastic-scintillator, liquid-argon detectors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-supervised pretraining with relational objectives learns reusable detector representations that reduce downstream labelled-data requirements
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pretrained model matches scratch performance with 10× fewer labels; cross-domain transfer observed

title: Duality-enabled unification of diffusion and wave control via Laplacian constitutive design
task: Unified control of diffusion and wave dynamics via Laplacian constitutive design and duality
key_results: Potential-eikonal duality translates Laplacian profiles into precise thermal/acoustic/electromagnetic field control; force-flow duality (2D Hodge) enables multidirectional adaptation; freeform cloaking and transparency in Hermitian and non-Hermitian media
comments: Elegant theoretical framework overcoming quasistatic and geometric constraints; unification via dualities is conceptually novel though experimental validation not reported in abstract.

model_io.model: Duality-assisted constitutive design framework (potential-eikonal and force-flow dualities)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Duality-based reformulation of diffusion and wave controls enables unified framework via Laplacian constitutive design
hypotheses.result: Proposed and theoretically validated; overcomes quasistatic and geometric constraints

title: Largest eigenvalue statistics of wavefront shaping in complex scattering media
task: Characterize enhancement-factor fluctuations in wavefront shaping through complex scattering media via random-matrix theory
key_results: Exact finite-size random-matrix theory predicts mean and fluctuations in weakly scattering/limited-channel regimes; strongly scattering media show giant fluctuations exceeding parameter-free predictions, indicating long-range mesoscopic correlations
comments: Rigorous theory-experiment agreement reveals enhancement factor as sensitive mesoscopic correlations probe; practical wavefront-shaping robustness implications merit exploration.

model_io.model: Wavefront shaping in complex scattering media with controllable input channels for multi-target focusing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Random-matrix theory describes enhancement-factor distribution in weakly scattering media
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; predictions accurate beyond Marčenko-Pastur regime when mesoscopic correlations negligible

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strongly scattering media exhibit enhancement fluctuations beyond random-matrix predictions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; indicates long-range mesoscopic correlations

title: Attosecond current control and timing in a scanning tunnelling microscope
task: Achieve attosecond control of tunneling current direction in scanning tunneling microscope using two-color laser pulses
key_results: Directional control of STM tunneling currents via sub-cycle waveform; current burst duration 860 as; sub-angström topographic sensitivity and 2 nm lateral resolution under ambient conditions
comments: Remarkable attosecond-scale spatial-temporal control in STM, though ambient-condition artifact-freedom claim requires scrutiny for reproducibility.

model_io.model: STM with two-color laser pulse excitation in non-adiabatic tunneling regime

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sub-cycle laser waveform controls attosecond current direction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; three-step transport mechanism identified with 860 as current duration

title: Deterministic and programmable fusion for the scalable generation of photonic graph states
task: Demonstrate deterministic fusion for scalable photonic graph-state synthesis
key_results: Genuine multipartite entanglement across 13 photonic qubits; deterministic fusion via Bell-state projection with built-in error mitigation on superconducting circuit
comments: 13-qubit entanglement is modest but demonstrates a scalable divide-and-conquer approach circumventing decoherence through active qubit reset.

model_io.model: Superconducting circuit with time-bin-encoded photons and integrated error mitigation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic fusion can enable scalable graph-state synthesis
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated with 13-qubit entanglement and reconfigurable states

title: Evolution laws of wellbore annular multiphase flow under coexisting overflow and lost circulation conditions
task: Characterize multiphase flow behavior under coexisting overflow and lost circulation in deep wells
key_results: Identified three flow patterns (bubbly, cap-bubble, churn); Scenario 2 exhibits bubbly-to-cap-bubble transition at 5 m³/h lost-circulation rate; pressure-gradient prediction error <10% after correction
comments: Large-scale visualization experiment (10 m, 130.9 mm annulus) provides rare experimental data; mechanistic loss-mode distinction is insightful.

model_io.model: 10 m large-diameter annular experimental device with independent gas-injection and lost-circulation ports

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flow pattern response differs between scenarios due to loss-mode distinction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Scenario 1 flow unchanged; Scenario 2 shows bubbly-to-cap-bubble transition at 5 m³/h

title: Centralized money, fragmented labor: wage bargaining and asymmetric adjustment in EMU
task: Analyze interaction between centralized monetary policy and heterogeneous wage bargaining in EMU labor-market adjustment
key_results: Framework identifies wage bargaining as key transmission channel for monetary policy effects; coordination, employer organization, openness, and size determine asymmetric adjustment across member states
comments: Institutional analysis provides useful conceptual clarity but lacks quantitative empirical validation across economies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Centralized monetary regime with heterogeneous labor institutions causes asymmetric macroeconomic adjustment
hypotheses.result: Supported by comparative institutional analysis; recent inflation challenges the framework

title: Competition between vacancy creation and filling in defect-engineering of hBN
task: Identify dominant defect-creation and defect-filling mechanisms in ultra-low-energy Ar+ irradiated monolayer hBN
key_results: Ultra-low-energy (150 eV) Ar+ irradiation predominantly creates boron single vacancies (~60%), followed by double vacancies (~30%); vacancy filling with Si/C impurities more significant than predicted
comments: Analytical-potential MD predictions fail; impurity-filling competition poses practical challenges for selective quantum-emitter engineering in hBN.

model_io.model: Monolayer hBN with 150 eV Ar+ ion irradiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Analytical-potential MD correctly predicts defect creation in low-energy Ar+ irradiation
hypotheses.result: Refuted; boron single vacancies dominate contrary to simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vacancy filling with Si/C is minor
hypotheses.result: Refuted; becomes significant limiting factor

title: Orbital transport in W revealed by THz spectroscopy
task: Elucidate terahertz emission mechanisms from orbital currents in ferromagnetic/non-magnetic heterostructures
key_results: Identified orbital currents as dominant THz emission source, converted via inverse orbital Hall effect in W and inverse orbital Rashba-Edelstein effect at W/MgO interface
comments: Transfer matrix analysis elegantly decouples competing mechanisms, though practical device applications remain undemonstrated.

model_io.model: Co-Pt/W/MgO heterostructure with femtosecond optical excitation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orbital currents dominate THz emission in Co-Pt/W/MgO
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via transfer matrix thickness dependence analysis
